top_paper.title: Efficient Streaming Audio-Visual Target Speaker Extraction for Real-World Acoustic Scenes
top_paper.summary: Falcon is a lightweight causal audio-visual target speaker extraction method that achieves high quality with drastically reduced parameters and latency, supported by the realistic RealSSA benchmark.

papers.title: Co-Design Bench: Multimodal Collaborative Coding Evaluation for Agentic Models
papers.summary: Evaluating human-AI co-design requires testing whether coding agents can translate real users' multimodal requests into working application revisions. We introduce Co-Design Bench, a reference-free benchmark of 273 tasks curated from 37,463 deduplicated queries across 26,314 real user coding sessions. Its two tracks, Multimodal Editing (ME) and Repository Editing (RE), cover localized edits with optional image, audio, video, or document inputs and coordinated repository revisions. Tasks span three capability dimensions: Grounded Understanding, UI Transformation, and Functional Implementation.

papers.title: AskStream: When and What to Ask Proactively under Uncertainty in Streaming Video Understanding
papers.summary: Proactive video understanding should include asking for missing information under uncertainty, and the AskStream benchmark reveals current models struggle with this decision.

papers.title: EditAgent: Rethinking Agentic Image Editing
papers.summary: EditAgent broadens agentic image editing by routing steps to diverse editors and using verification records for listwise judging, improving reliability and efficiency.

papers.title: WeVisCut: The Whole Editing Room in One Agent From Narration to Long-Form Video
papers.summary: WeVisCut is a script-to-video system that trains a compact policy to coordinate video editing tools, recover from failures, and reduce token usage while maintaining quality.

papers.title: IntReal: A Real-World Dataset and Benchmark for Multimodal Interleaved Generation
papers.summary: IntReal introduces a real-world interleaved multimodal dataset and evaluation framework to diagnose unified model strengths and improve generation through targeted training.

papers.title: VibeGame: Prompt-to-Game Development with AI-Native Engine and Self-Evolving Adversarial Agent Team
papers.summary: VibeGame is a framework that uses specialized adversarial agents and an AI-native engine to build complete 2D games from natural-language prompts with interactive validation and self-evolving reusable components.

papers.title: WebAnything: From the Wild Web to Scalable Agent Environments
papers.summary: WebAnything automates the reconstruction of reusable, source-grounded web environments from real URLs, enabling scalable agent training and evaluation with verified fidelity.

papers.title: WorkFactory: Turning Professional Intents into Executable Work for Scalable Agent Training
papers.summary: WorkFactory builds coherent professional tasks via information planning and repair, yielding WorkPilot models that improve expert-level agent performance across benchmarks.

papers.title: After One-Click Video: The Inflow of Service-Type Content, the Failure of the Recommendation Pool Mechanism, and the BoLe System
papers.summary: AI-generated video tools shift content production toward service-type material, unbalancing the industry and overwhelming recommendation systems, prompting a dual-judgment BoLe framework to protect work-type content.

papers.title: PreView: Enhancing GUI Grounding with Preprocessed Views and Cues
papers.summary: PreView is an auxiliary preprocessor that enhances GUI grounding by providing localized zoomed views and visual-textual target cues to frozen grounding models, improving accuracy without retraining.

papers.title: PersonaCUABench: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agents Serving Diverse Personas
papers.summary: PersonaCUABench reveals that computer-use agents frequently fail to satisfy real user requirements and constraints, reducing task completion and satisfaction compared to fixed benchmark instructions.

papers.title: LOB-Impact Benchmark: Emergent Market Impact in Generative Limit Order Book Models
papers.summary: Neural generative limit order book models trained for next-token prediction exhibit emergent market impact under metaorder injection, though relaxation decay remains unobserved due to limited context windows.

papers.title: Know, then Draw: A New Learning Paradigm for Visual Generation
papers.summary: A hybrid paradigm combining autoregressive pretraining for semantics and diffusion post-training for rendering achieves efficient, high-quality text-to-image generation with favorable scaling laws.

papers.title: Instruction Capacity: Behavior and Degradation of Language Models under Controlled Load
papers.summary: Researchers developed a statistical instrument using atomic replacement rules to measure language model instruction capacity with quantified uncertainty, finding GPT-4o mini holds about 37-38 rules at 95% accuracy.

papers.title: Evaluating DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 for loss of control and harmful manipulation risks
papers.summary: Independent safety evaluation of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 reveals substantial improvements over prior versions and near-parity with leading closed-source models, while recommending process-level observability, incremental safety testing, and private benchmarks.

papers.title: Amortizing Sequential Experimental Design in Reasoning LLMs
papers.summary: Large language models learn adaptive information gathering by training reasoning with information-gain rewards, improving experimental design efficiency and generalizing across tasks.

papers.title: RealCLI: Toward a Unified Evaluation of Human-Agent Collaboration for CLI Agents
papers.summary: REALCLI is a benchmark that jointly evaluates CLI agent task execution and human-agent collaboration quality, revealing major gaps in steerability, trust calibration, and safety management.

papers.title: LongZero: Enhancing Long-Context Reasoning in LLMs from Zero Data
papers.summary: LongZero enables large language models to self-improve long-context reasoning by synthesizing structured multi-hop and retrieval tasks and training with GRPO without external data.

papers.title: TauIndianBankBench: Procedure-Aware, Action-Oriented Evaluation of Tool-Using Conversational Agents
papers.summary: TauIndianBankBench evaluates language model assistants on Indian retail banking by verifying both procedural compliance and final outcomes across 1,000 simulated tasks.

papers.title: CausGround: Causal Interaction Grounding for Adaptive Embodied Planning
papers.summary: CausGround extracts reusable action preconditions and effects from interaction experience to improve embodied planning and reasoning across diverse environments without model retraining.

papers.title: HuGe: Scaling Humanoid Generalist Vision-Language-Action Models with Egocentric Experience
papers.summary: HuGe pre-trains vision-language-action models on egocentric human and robot data with pseudo-proprioception and visual adaptation to enable whole-body humanoid control.

papers.title: OmniSpectra: A Unified Foundation Model for Universal Spectra Representation Learning
papers.summary: OmniSpectra is a wavelength-native spectral foundation model that uses continuous coordinates and physics-grounded decoders to learn cross-instrument representations without destructive resampling, achieving high performance with far fewer parameters.

papers.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
papers.summary: Sensorimotor alignment measures how sensory representations match physical motion geometry, serving as a low-cost offline predictor of robot model performance.

papers.title: TAO: Tool-Aware Joint Scheduling for LLM-Based Agentic Serving
papers.summary: TAO improves scheduling for LLM agent services by considering tool readiness and using dynamic programming to place sessions, reducing latency and increasing throughput.

papers.title: OmniShowcase: Omnidirectional Subject-Consistent Video Generation from Multi-View Images
papers.summary: OmniShowcase improves subject-to-video generation by using geometry-driven training data and surface-normal conditioning to maintain 3D consistency across novel viewpoints.

papers.title: Efficient Streaming Audio-Visual Target Speaker Extraction for Real-World Acoustic Scenes
papers.summary: Falcon is a lightweight causal audio-visual target speaker extraction method that achieves high quality with drastically reduced parameters and latency, supported by the realistic RealSSA benchmark.

papers.title: AdaPRA: Process Reward Agents with Adaptive Rubrics for Data Science
papers.summary: AdaPRA improves data science agents via persistent knowledge accumulation and adaptive rubric-guided process supervision, reducing errors and boosting leaderboard performance.

papers.title: Self-Assessment Reinforcement Learning for Search-State Awareness in Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
papers.summary: Self-Assessment Reinforcement Learning trains search agents to recognize missing information and improve search efficiency without extra inference-time assessment.

papers.title: Quaternion Approximate Networks for Enhanced Image Classification and Oriented Object Detection
papers.summary: QUAN is a quaternion-based deep learning framework that approximates quaternion convolution with real-valued operations to achieve rotation-equivariant image classification and object detection with improved efficiency.

papers.title: AlphaBet: Reinforcement Learning for LLM Event Forecasting Agents
papers.summary: AlphaBet uses agentic reinforcement learning to train a single LLM policy to search, reason, and report forecast probabilities across multiple dates, reducing Brier scores by improving both evidence acquisition and probability reporting.
